title: Scaling Instruction-Finetuned Language Models
authors: H. Chung, L. Hou, S. Longpre, et al. (35 authors)
before: Instruction tuning had been shown on dozens of tasks at moderate scale.
problem: Did it keep working with more tasks, bigger models and reasoning data mixed in?
breakthrough: Scale to 1,800 tasks and add chain-of-thought examples to the instruction mixture.
why: It made instruction tuning a scalable recipe, and the released Flan-T5 models became a research workhorse.
next: The Flan collection fed open instruction datasets; the recipe is standard post-training practice.
inherits: Instruction mixtures that include reasoning traces.
